Figures for the DESeq2 results. Input is saved at the end of `deseq2-analysis.qmd`.

```{r}
inp <- readRDS("data/processed/deseq2_output_Colon_Sigmoid_vs_Whole_Blood.rds")
res <- inp$res
s <- inp$settings
```

# Volcano plot

padj capped at 1e-300 since smaller values underflow to 0 and wouldn't be drawn. Red = higher in the numerator tissue (right), blue = higher in the reference tissue (left).

```{r}
hit <- res$padj < s$alpha & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > s$lfc_cutoff
plot(res$log2FoldChange, pmin(-log10(res$padj), 300), pch = 19, cex = 0.3, col = ifelse(!hit, "black", ifelse(res$log2FoldChange > 0, "red", "blue")),
     xlab = paste("Log2 FC", s$comparison), ylab = "-log10(padj), capped at 300")
```

# Single donor vs all donors

```{r}
donor <- inp$coldata$SUBJID[1] # first donor in the list - assuming it's representative
donor
target <- inp$norm_counts[, inp$coldata$SUBJID == donor & inp$coldata$tissue == s$target_level]
ref <- inp$norm_counts[, inp$coldata$SUBJID == donor & inp$coldata$tissue == s$ref_level]
donor_lfc <- log2((target + 1) / (ref + 1))

plot(res$log2FoldChange, donor_lfc, pch = 19, cex = 0.3, main = s$comparison, xlab = "Log2 FC, all donors", ylab = paste("Log2 FC,", donor))
abline(lm(donor_lfc ~ res$log2FoldChange), col = "red")
```
